triples.subject: Trial of Dmitri Karamazov
triples.quote: At ten o’clock in the morning of the day following the events I have described, the trial of Dmitri Karamazov began in our district court.

triples.subject: Dmitri Karamazov
triples.quote: The court usher was told to bring in the prisoner, and Mitya made his appearance.

triples.subject: Fyodor Pavlovitch
triples.quote: They had already seen “the woman who had ruined Fyodor Pavlovitch and his unhappy son,”

triples.subject: Fyodor Pavlovitch
triples.quote: wondered how father and son could be so in love with “such a very common, ordinary Russian girl, who was not even pretty.”

triples.subject: Dmitri Karamazov
triples.quote: wondered how father and son could be so in love with “such a very common, ordinary Russian girl, who was not even pretty.”

triples.subject: Katerina Ivanovna
triples.quote: The public was looking forward with anxious curiosity to the meeting of the two rivals—the proud aristocratic girl and “the hetaira.”

triples.subject: Katerina Ivanovna
triples.quote: All sorts of extraordinary tales were told about her, amazing anecdotes of her passion for Mitya, in spite of his crime.

triples.subject: Ippolit Kirillovitch
triples.quote: It was said that Ippolit Kirillovitch was in a tremor at meeting Fetyukovitch, and that they had been enemies from the beginning of their careers in Petersburg

triples.subject: Fyodor Pavlovitch
triples.quote: On it lay Fyodor Pavlovitch’s white silk dressing-gown, stained with blood;

triples.subject: Fyodor Pavlovitch Karamazov
triples.quote: But I am not guilty of the death of that old man, my enemy and my father.

triples.subject: Dmitri Karamazov
triples.quote: But I am not guilty of the death of that old man, my enemy and my father.

triples.subject: Dmitri Karamazov
triples.quote: At last the President opened the case of the murder of Fyodor Pavlovitch Karamazov.

triples.subject: Dmitri Karamazov
triples.quote: The court usher was told to bring in the prisoner, and Mitya made his appearance.

triples.subject: Fetyukovitch
triples.quote: At the same moment the counsel for defense, the celebrated Fetyukovitch, entered, and a sort of subdued hum passed through the court.

triples.subject: Miüsov
triples.quote: Four of the witnesses were not present—Miüsov, who had given evidence at the preliminary inquiry, but was now in Paris;
